mechanism_narrative: A lower FEDFUNDS rate (as a continuous variable) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL value above 3.5% signals persistent inflation, which triggers monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between CPIAUCSL (above 3.5%) and 20-day forward returns is positive or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS falls > 100k in 3 months
failure_condition: The correlation between the interaction condition (UNRATE rise > 0.2pp in 3 months AND PAYEMS fall > 100k in 3 months) and 20-day forward returns is positive or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime where GDP (GDPC1) exceeds 23000 billion (2017 dollars) and housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1300 thousand units, strong economic fundamentals drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between the condition (GDPC1 > 23000 AND HOUST > 1300) and 20-day forward returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher INDPRO level (as a continuous variable) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as it reflects robust industrial activity and economic expansion.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO and 60-day forward returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness and potential recession, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between UNRATE (above 5.0%) and 5-day forward returns is positive or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals an impending monetary tightening cycle, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL > 3.5%
failure_condition: The correlation between the interaction condition (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.25pp in 3 months AND CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and 20-day forward returns is positive or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A higher HOUST level (as a continuous variable) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects strong housing market activity and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and 20-day forward returns is negative or insignificant (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window.
